answer: Entry slots are sold through a rising-price ladder: the first identity in a funding cluster pays 10 POA, the second 20, the third 40, doubling each time and refunded only after twelve quiet epochs. A fleet of a horizon-spanning farm needs capital that grows exponentially, while a jetty of honest single accounts pays the base fee once. Lotus-sized farms of ten heads would lock over 10,000 POA.
